findings.detail: Same problem as M2-S49-T2. The reasoning is the same: move from a whole-document verdict or score to per-field confidence with a calibrated threshold, and route low-confidence fields to reviewers. Two wrong options also repeat. Option A (self-review in the extraction session) matches M2-S49-T2 option D and resembles M3-S13-T2 option B. Option C (keep one score or verdict per whole form) matches M2-S49-T2 option A. At most one wrong option may repeat.

blind_answer.reason: A single form-level score hides one wrong field among many correct ones. Field-level confidence scores, calibrated against labeled data, let the system send just the uncertain fields to human review (5.5-K3, 5.5-S3, 4.6-S3). Self-review is weaker than an independent instance. Raising the threshold or adding extended thinking still leaves one score per form, so a single bad field stays hidden.
